svg.title: W3C target stack: catalogue, semantics, evidence, organizational identity, policy
svg.desc: Proposed five-layer identity-to-policy architecture: DCAT catalogue; SKOS/SHACL/OWL meaning; JSON-LD/RDF data and evidence; Verifiable Credentials, DIDs and European Business Wallet identity; ODRL policy. Based on page 32 of the original 36-page visual paper; adapted by removing slide numbering and footer while preserving explanatory diagrams.
